summary.text: David Paige is a Democratic state representative from Carroll 1 who has served in the House since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Paige is a business executive with a background in publishing.

paragraphs.text: David Paige's career experience includes working as director of Libraries Unlimited with Bloomsbury USA, as an executive with ABC-CLIO, and as an editorial assistant with Ugly Duckling Presse.
He has served as a trustee of Northeast Woodland School and of the Conway Public Library.
